title: A language hard for bounded-size DAG circuits
statement: There is a language $L$ over Boolean strings such that, for every function $T\colon\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$ for which some $n$ satisfies $1<n$ and $T(n)\le 2^n/(10n)$, no family of well-formed acyclic Boolean circuits with at most two inputs to each gate, size at most $T(n)$ on inputs of length $n$, recognizes $L$.
